title: Irrigation audit and repair for a View Royal townhouse strata

seo.title: Sample project: View Royal irrigation audit | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: a zone-by-zone irrigation audit and repair for a View Royal townhouse strata, finished with a zone map for council.

summary: A zone-by-zone check and repair of an older strata irrigation system.
scope: Controller reset to CRD lawn days for the complex address
challenge: Some lawns at the townhouse complex were soggy while others browned, and nobody had a zone map.
approach: We ran every zone, replaced broken heads and a sticking valve, and set the controller to the lawn watering days for the complex's street address.
Council received a simple zone map it can hand to any contractor.
result: Even coverage and a zone map the strata can hand to any contractor.
